title: Reach: public web, Reddit, GitHub and YouTube reader
summary: Read-only public internet reader inspired by Agent Reach: searches and reads Reddit (posts, subreddits, top comments via public web index), general web pages (Exa search and Jina Reader), GitHub repos/issues, and YouTube metadata with zero API keys, zero login, external-gate enforcement, daily request caps, and untrusted-output tagging.
enableWhen: the crew needs read-only access to public web, Reddit, GitHub or YouTube content without managing platform logins or API keys

tools.purpose: search and read public Reddit, web, GitHub and YouTube content through allowlisted read-only backends with daily caps and compact JSON/TSV digests

limits.why: daily request cap, per-query result cap, response char cap and timeout; shipped closed, and the safe defaults below become the opened copy when the owner enables the module (read-only, so no limit call is needed first)

meters.why: append-only log of outbound reach queries (channel, action, backend, ok, item count, chars)

allowlist.why: public read-only semantic search and page fetch MCP used by reach.js for web, Reddit and YouTube discovery
public read-only Markdown page reader used by reach.js to read web pages cleanly
GitHub public read-only REST API for repositories, READMEs and issues
Reddit public post and subreddit URL scope for read-only reach queries
Reddit public URL scope for read-only reach queries
